items.description: One row per group. Holds the group_by keys (client is an object with id, name, company_slug, bucket; resource also carries provider), then the totals.

callback_url.description: An https URL that receives the finished job (signed with X-Demo-Signature).

force_run.description: Run the reports even when one completed in the last 7 days.

industry.description: Accepted for parity with AdVisor; not used by Socialytics.

build.description: Hash of the deployed API function source; equals BUILD_STAMP in supabase/functions/api/build-stamp.ts on the commit it was built from.

name.description: 1 to 80 characters after trimming, with at least one visible character and no line breaks, tabs or other control characters.

industry_trends.description: The themes the weekly trend collection stored for the weeks that start inside the report's period (newest week first), each with its example posts. Null when none.

Session.description: A Socialytics sign-in session token, for Moburst staff only.

info.description: Everything Socialytics holds for the clients a key may see (clients with their brand, pillars and design, social and competitive reports with their decks, competitor sets, generated posts and media, schedules, scheduled posts, competitive alerts, design systems, Sprout performance, health), plus the ad-hoc demo job that onboards any brand from a name and a website and runs every feature for it, and what Socialytics' paid providers cost per client, service and period (the costs scope). Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The personal key routes under /v1/me take a Socialytics sign-in session instead, for Moburst staff only. Lists are paginated with `limit` and `cursor`.
